fixtures: ALL fixtures are SYNTHETIC adversarial track/replay constructions (labeled synthetic in the test file). No held-out cases (wm-dink-01, afn-vic-rally1) were used or touched. No canonical cascade numbers were produced (Linux; pose extraction is macOS-only).
contracts: usable-result-v1 and silent-failure-v1 untouched. All hardening is ADDITIVE metadata (identityContests on PlayerTrack, contested/jumped + followContestedFrames/followJumps on ReplayResult, new risk strings, confidence caps). No decision path of the shipped follower or tracker was changed; no blanket abstention was introduced.

breaks.scenario: SYNTHETIC: user tap exactly equidistant between two players
breaks.pre_fix: one player silently chosen, confidence 0.55, zero risks
breaks.fix: TAP_AMBIGUITY_COST_RATIO=0.65 gate adds TARGET_TAP_AMBIGUOUS risk and caps confidence at 0.45
breaks.regression_test: test/d3-01-targetPersistence.test.ts: 'a tap equidistant between two players surfaces TARGET_TAP_AMBIGUOUS'

breaks.scenario: SYNTHETIC: clothing-similar DISTINCT person standing at normalized torso distance 0.10 from the target
breaks.pre_fix: second human's frames silently absorbed as duplicate aliases (DUPLICATE_TORSO_DISTANCE=0.12), blending two people into one identity
breaks.fix: alias absorption now requires median coincident torso distance <= ALIAS_TIGHT_MEDIAN_DISTANCE (0.08; measured true duplicates sit at 0.058/0.068). Looser coincident tracks are NOT absorbed and add TARGET_ALIAS_LOOSE risk with confidence capped at 0.5
breaks.regression_test: 'an adjacent DISTINCT person ... is NOT absorbed' + tight-duplicate positive guard

breaks.scenario: SYNTHETIC: two similar players crossing / merging into one detection while overlapped; target dropout while a bystander passes through the target's position
breaks.pre_fix: greedy association silently kept or handed off identity with zero surfaced signal; incumbentAdvantage multiplier scaled all costs equally (a no-op for assignment order)
breaks.fix: per-frame identity-contest detection (rival feasible pair within contestCostRatio=1.5 or +0.02 absolute) recorded as identityContests on the track; selectTargetPlayer and initializeTargetFromSeed add TARGET_IDENTITY_CONTESTED risk and cap confidence at 0.5. Geometry alone cannot decide which human is which in these frames — that residual is disclosed, not hidden.
breaks.regression_test: 'two similar players crossing produce identityContests', 'merge-cross ... records contests', 'target dropout while a bystander passes'

breaks.scenario: SYNTHETIC: target exits frame ~1s and re-enters
breaks.pre_fix: already safe: gap > maxGapMs(400) forces a NEW track; no silent stitch. Pinned as regression.
breaks.regression_test: 'a target that leaves and returns keeps explicit loss periods'

breaks.scenario: SYNTHETIC replay (shipped variant, follower hysteresis on): target dropout while a mover passes; decisively larger challenger approaching
breaks.pre_fix: post-lock follower silently handed the anchor to another body (anchor jump > incumbent radius) with zero surfaced signal
breaks.fix: replayAcquisition now emits per-frame contested/jumped flags plus followContestedFrames and followJumps totals (rival within FOLLOW_CONTEST_SCORE_RATIO=0.7 of chosen, >=2 people inside FOLLOW_INCUMBENT_RADIUS=0.12, or one-frame anchor move > radius). Decision logic is unchanged (shipped semantics pinned by existing taVariantsW3 tests).
breaks.open: OPEN: the live device follower (ApplePoseProvider.primaryPerson) can still physically follow the wrong human in these geometries; the replay-side signal makes the hazard measurable and available to gate on, but wiring a live confidence drop/abstain into the device pipeline is out of D3-01 package scope and needs the D-027 live tap instrumentation data.
breaks.regression_test: 'target dropout while a mover passes = contested frames + an anchor jump', 'decisively larger challenger', clean-follow negative guard

coverage_delta.method: no committed positive gold for target acquisition exists as runnable fixtures on Linux (canonical run dirs absent); coverage guard is the synthetic clean-geometry suite instead
coverage_delta.result: clean solo-player and well-separated two-player fixtures: 0 contests, 0 new risks, confidence unchanged (>=0.9 seeded); tight true-duplicate absorption (measured 0.058/0.068 analogue) still absorbs silently. Full swing-lab suite (231 tests) green before and after.
